title: SecurePride disclosure, coercion and continuity of care
license: Apache-2.0, as the rest of the repository. Cited sources are linked, not republished, and keep their own licences.
evidence_note: Sources support context or mechanisms, not these invented events. No deployed controls or behavioral test results are asserted.

scenarios.title: Reminder discloses a care association
scenarios.adversary_capability: Household observer who can see a notification
scenarios.affected_parties: Client and anyone inferred to be their partner
scenarios.harm: Outing, coercion or withdrawal from care
scenarios.proposed_control: Client-approved channel, timing and wording, including sender display
scenarios.prerequisites: A safely agreed contact preference and a fallback reachable by the client
scenarios.control_induced_harm: Neutral wording may be confusing; disabling all reminders may cause missed contact
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Use the agreed alternative contact route; revert wording only with recipient approval
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Synthetic reminder with neutral body but a revealing clinic sender label
probe_steps: Display on a locked shared test device
Inspect sender, preview and linked device display
Repeat using the intended fallback
scenarios.expected_result: Review catches sender disclosure and fallback works without requiring the unsafe channel
scenarios.residual_risk: Message-provider records and physical observation remain

scenarios.title: Context survives pattern redaction
scenarios.adversary_capability: Reader who can correlate a public event listing
scenarios.exposure: Unique combination of event, role and place
scenarios.affected_parties: Person described, even if identification is mistaken
scenarios.harm: Involuntary attribution of sensitive care information
scenarios.proposed_control: No safety authorization from scanner output; minimize context and use synthetic examples
scenarios.prerequisites: Known sharing purpose and a reviewer able to assess contextual linkage
scenarios.control_induced_harm: Over-redaction can remove information needed for legitimate care
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Withhold public narrative and use a separately reviewed minimum clinical communication
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Invented person is the only speaker in an invented event roster; narrative omits their name
probe_steps: Compare narrative with synthetic roster
Remove a direct identifier and repeat
Inspect the proposed no-match result wording
scenarios.expected_result: No-match never authorizes sharing; remaining linkage is explicitly identified
scenarios.residual_risk: Reviewer knowledge is incomplete; no general anonymity guarantee

scenarios.title: Assessment leaves a shared-device trace
scenarios.adversary_capability: Later user of the same browser profile
scenarios.affected_parties: Visitor and people described in answers
scenarios.proposed_control: Static guidance first; no automatic answer persistence, transmission or export
scenarios.prerequisites: Explicit inventory of browser state and hosting data flows
scenarios.control_induced_harm: No autosave can lose work; downloads can expose it through sync
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Use non-personal static guidance; user controls whether to create an export
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Synthetic answers entered into a shared test-browser session
probe_steps: Inspect network and storage during success and error paths
Reload, reopen and test back/forward and session restore
Inspect URL and exported-file behavior
scenarios.expected_result: Documented no-answer-transmission/persistence contract holds for tested paths; no no-traces claim
scenarios.residual_risk: OS screenshots, monitoring, browser history and compromised endpoints

scenarios.title: Device restriction interrupts care
scenarios.adversary_capability: Policy operator making an unsafe recommendation; coercive household context
scenarios.affected_parties: Person relying on the device for services
scenarios.harm: Loss of service access or increased dependency
scenarios.proposed_control: Ownership-specific advice; prerequisites, recovery and essential-task testing
scenarios.prerequisites: Verified backup/recovery and independently usable care fallback before disruptive changes
scenarios.control_induced_harm: Supervision can erase a configured phone; restrictions may block essential functions
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Defer the change if fallback is unsafe; use the reviewed device recovery procedure
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Test phone with synthetic portal and a second channel controlled by the same fictional household member
probe_steps: Trace setup and recovery prerequisites
Test portal and authentication under the proposed policy
Check who controls every fallback factor
scenarios.expected_result: Unsafe dependency blocks the recommendation; essential care remains reachable
scenarios.residual_risk: Later platform or service changes need retesting

scenarios.title: Offboarding misses an active session
scenarios.adversary_capability: Former worker with a valid session or export
scenarios.proposed_control: Individual accounts, session revocation, access and export review
scenarios.prerequisites: Inventory of applications, shared credentials and recovery privileges
scenarios.control_induced_harm: Revocation without handover can strand active client work
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Transfer necessary work to an authorized person without restoring departed access
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Synthetic volunteer account with two sessions and an exported dummy file
probe_steps: Disable account
Attempt access using both sessions
Check ownership handover and document retained export limits
scenarios.expected_result: Live access is denied and work continues; no claim that prior copies are erased
scenarios.residual_risk: Previously copied data may remain outside service control

scenarios.title: Endpoint compromise defeats message confidentiality
scenarios.adversary_capability: Targeted actor with endpoint execution capability
scenarios.affected_parties: Device user and their support network
scenarios.proposed_control: Updates, appropriate Lockdown Mode, data minimization and qualified incident escalation
scenarios.prerequisites: Supported device and reviewed essential workflows; evidence-preservation plan if an incident is suspected
scenarios.control_induced_harm: Feature limits may disrupt contact; a reset can destroy useful evidence
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Use a separately assessed communication route and specialist recovery guidance
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Paper scenario in which an attacker can read content after decryption on one endpoint
probe_steps: Trace where content exists as plaintext
Compare this with encryption and Lockdown claims
Walk through escalation without submitting real records
scenarios.expected_result: Guidance does not claim encryption or a negative scan proves endpoint safety
scenarios.residual_risk: Unknown exploits and incomplete forensic visibility

scenarios.title: Recovery returns control to an abuser
scenarios.adversary_capability: Household member controlling a recovery number or email
scenarios.harm: Coercion and loss of independent care contact
scenarios.prerequisites: Safe ability to change factors; independently controlled recovery path
scenarios.control_induced_harm: Changes may notify the other party or lock the person out
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Defer visible changes where unsafe; agree on a safely reachable support route
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Synthetic account whose primary and backup recovery routes share one controller
probe_steps: Map controllers of all factors
Trace notifications caused by changes
Attempt a loss-of-device walkthrough
scenarios.expected_result: Shared control is identified; a nominal second factor is not counted as independent
scenarios.residual_risk: Physical coercion and total factor loss

scenarios.title: Aggregate reporting identifies a small group
scenarios.affected_parties: People counted, including falsely attributed individuals
scenarios.proposed_control: Necessity and linkage review; carefully governed aggregation and release
scenarios.prerequisites: Understanding of recipient and available auxiliary data
scenarios.control_induced_harm: Suppressing data can obscure service inequities
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Use a broader reviewed report or controlled access preserving necessary service insight
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Synthetic two-row cohort table joined with a public fictional event list
probe_steps: Attempt linkage using the synthetic external list
Review repeated releases for differencing
Check whether the revised report still serves its purpose
scenarios.expected_result: Reviewer identifies re-identification and repeat-release risk before publication
scenarios.residual_risk: Unknown auxiliary data; no universal small-cell threshold guarantees anonymity

scenarios.title: Impersonated service extracts information
scenarios.adversary_capability: Attacker impersonating a familiar care worker
scenarios.exposure: Credentials, codes or private case information
scenarios.proposed_control: Verify through an independently established channel before sensitive action
scenarios.prerequisites: Accessible verification route agreed before the suspicious request
scenarios.control_induced_harm: Overly difficult verification may delay legitimate support
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Offer a known service contact and safe non-sensitive interim assistance
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Invented urgent message from a lookalike service contact requesting a verification code
probe_steps: Trace the requested action
Verify using a previously established contact
Check accessibility when the usual channel is unavailable
scenarios.expected_result: No code or private record is disclosed; legitimate assistance remains reachable
scenarios.residual_risk: The established channel can itself be compromised

scenarios.title: Administration becomes a surveillance dependency
scenarios.harm: Expanded access, disruption or coerced control
scenarios.proposed_control: Minimal authority, separated administration and reviewed management visibility
scenarios.prerequisites: Actual platform/enrollment capability inventory and accountable operators
scenarios.control_induced_harm: Management can increase institutional power over a personal device
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Provide an agreed exit/recovery route; do not require enrollment for care
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Proposed management roles and enrollment design for fictional staff and client devices
probe_steps: List actual commands and data visible to each role
Trace administrator compromise
Walk through user exit and service continuity
scenarios.expected_result: Claims match real privileges; client device ownership is preserved
scenarios.residual_risk: Privileged compromise and external institutional pressure

scenarios.title: Public contribution leaks an incident
scenarios.adversary_capability: Public reader or external processing recipient
scenarios.exposure: Incident logs, screenshots or linked identities
scenarios.affected_parties: Client or worker whose data was copied
scenarios.proposed_control: Synthetic public reproductions and separately governed private intake
scenarios.prerequisites: Clear reporting routes, access and retention rules before solicitation
scenarios.control_induced_harm: Poor reproduction can impede fixing a real defect
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Request minimal non-sensitive technical facts through the appropriate process
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Synthetic bug-report attachment with contextual identifiers but no name
probe_steps: Review attachment and metadata
Attempt contextual linkage
Trace where public and private submissions would be retained
scenarios.expected_result: Sensitive context stays out of public issue and hosted scanner; useful synthetic repro retained
scenarios.residual_risk: Human oversharing and copies outside project control

scenarios.title: One export exposes a network
scenarios.adversary_capability: Insider or attacker controlling an authorized export-capable account
scenarios.affected_parties: Clients, partners, peer workers and recipients
scenarios.proposed_control: Minimum necessary exports, scoped roles and recipient review
scenarios.prerequisites: Known purpose, destination and dependency map
scenarios.care_fallback_and_recovery: Use a tested minimal referral route with accountable emergency exception handling
scenarios.synthetic_fixture: Fictional referral graph across two services and a broad export role
probe_steps: Trace compromise of the export role
Measure which synthetic relationships become visible
Test minimal legitimate referral and revocation
scenarios.expected_result: Unnecessary graph disclosure is prevented while required referral works
scenarios.residual_risk: Recipient compromise and misuse of legitimately shared information
